Schema-v4 input binds the freshly rebuilt executed post-chunk capacity validation and uses '-' only for its capacity-ineligible symmetric dense/XAttention pairs. Schema-v4 input and schema-v7 result are fully constructed at package-private pending paths; immediately before publication the package closures and starting selected-chunk hash are revalidated. One create-only transaction fsyncs both pending files, hard-links the input without overwrite, recomputes the result against that published input, hard-links and revalidates the result, rechecks the selected-chunk guard before and after directory fsync, and rolls back only the transaction-owned inodes on failure.
